plain_english_definition: Vital oxygen-carrying protein contained inside red blood cells.
low_value_meaning: Indicates anemia; reduces oxygen transport leading to fatigue, pallor, weakness, and dizziness.
high_value_meaning: Polycythemia; seen in chronic hypoxia, smoking, high altitude living, or bone marrow disorders.
diet_lifestyle_note: Consume dietary iron (leafy greens, lentils, beans) alongside Vitamin C to optimize absorption.

synonyms: Red Blood Cell Count, Total RBC, Erythrocytes
plain_english_definition: Total number of circulating red blood cells in the bloodstream.
low_value_meaning: Reflects diminished cell production or acute/chronic hemolysis; typical in nutritional anemia.
high_value_meaning: Hemoconcentration from dehydration or primary polycythemia.
diet_lifestyle_note: Maintain consistent daily hydration and consume foods rich in vitamin B12 and folate.

synonyms: WBC, Total Leukocyte Count, TLC, Leukocytes
plain_english_definition: Primary immune defense cells protecting against infections and foreign invaders.
low_value_meaning: Leukopenia; weakens immunity and elevates risk of opportunistic infections.
high_value_meaning: Leukocytosis; indicates active bacterial/viral infection, severe stress, or systemic inflammation.
associated_organs: Immune System, Bone Marrow, Lymph Nodes
diet_lifestyle_note: Support immune resilience with adequate sleep, antioxidant-rich foods, and proper hygiene.

plain_english_definition: Cellular fragments essential for physiological blood clotting and vascular repair.
low_value_meaning: Thrombocytopenia; elevates risk of easy bruising, petechiae, and prolonged bleeding.
high_value_meaning: Thrombocytosis; reactive elevation due to systemic infection, chronic inflammation, or iron deficiency.
diet_lifestyle_note: Avoid vigorous contact sports if critically low until evaluated by a hematologist.

plain_english_definition: Average physical size and volume of circulating red blood cells.
low_value_meaning: Microcytic anemia; cells are undersized, characteristic of iron deficiency or thalassemia trait.
high_value_meaning: Macrocytic anemia; abnormally enlarged cells, classically caused by Vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.
diet_lifestyle_note: A peripheral blood smear and vitamin deficiency workup is advised if abnormal.

plain_english_definition: Percentage proportion of total blood volume occupied by red blood cells.
low_value_meaning: Suggests low blood volume concentration, overhydration, or anemia.
high_value_meaning: Observed in severe acute dehydration or polycythemia vera.
diet_lifestyle_note: Maintain balanced electrolyte and fluid intake.

synonyms: Neutrophil Count, Absolute Neutrophil Count, ANC
plain_english_definition: First-responder white blood cells specialized in fighting acute bacterial infections.
low_value_meaning: Neutropenia; severely reduces defenses against bacterial invasion.
high_value_meaning: Neutrophilia; hallmark sign of active acute bacterial infection or tissue injury.
diet_lifestyle_note: Practice strict infection avoidance if neutropenic.

plain_english_definition: Specialized adaptive immune cells (T-cells, B-cells) that fight viral pathogens.
low_value_meaning: Lymphopenia; seen in acute viral infections, steroid use, or immune suppression.
high_value_meaning: Lymphocytosis; typical response to viral illnesses (mononucleosis, flu, measles).
diet_lifestyle_note: Ensure restorative rest and hydration during viral recovery.

plain_english_definition: Granulocyte immune cells involved in allergic responses and combating parasites.
low_value_meaning: Generally non-significant clinically.
high_value_meaning: Eosinophilia; classic marker for allergic diseases (asthma, eczema) or parasitic infections.
diet_lifestyle_note: Track potential food or environmental allergen triggers.

plain_english_definition: Metabolic waste from normal muscle breakdown, cleared exclusively by glomerular filtration.
low_value_meaning: Rare; seen with severe muscle wasting, advanced liver disease, or prolonged bed rest.
high_value_meaning: Indicates reduced kidney filtration efficiency, dehydration, or renal impairment.
diet_lifestyle_note: Avoid self-medicating with non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) like ibuprofen.

plain_english_definition: Nitrogen quantity in blood formed from hepatic protein catabolism, excreted by kidneys.
low_value_meaning: Seen in low-protein diets, severe liver disease, or overhydration.
high_value_meaning: Suggests impaired renal excretion, dehydration, high-protein intake, or gastrointestinal bleeding.
diet_lifestyle_note: Maintain consistent fluid intake and ensure balanced dietary protein.

plain_english_definition: Byproduct chemical generated when the body metabolizes purine nucleosides.
low_value_meaning: Rarely significant; can be observed on strict low-purine diets.
high_value_meaning: Hyperuricemia; crystals can precipitate in joints causing acute gout attacks or nephrolithiasis.
diet_lifestyle_note: Moderate consumption of purine-dense foods (red meat, seafood, beer, high-fructose syrups).

plain_english_definition: Calculated estimate of the filtering capacity of the kidney glomeruli.
low_value_meaning: eGFR < 60 indicates chronic kidney disease; eGFR < 15 indicates kidney failure.
high_value_meaning: Normal, healthy filtration capacity.
diet_lifestyle_note: Control blood pressure and blood glucose to preserve filtration function.

synonyms: ALT, SGPT, Serum Glutamic Pyruvic Transaminase
plain_english_definition: Intracellular hepatic enzyme that leaks into circulation during hepatocellular injury.
low_value_meaning: Low levels are physiologically normal and expected.
high_value_meaning: Indicates hepatocellular inflammation, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), or hepatitis.
diet_lifestyle_note: Eliminate alcohol, reduce refined sugars, and engage in daily physical exercise.

synonyms: AST, SGOT, Serum Glutamic Oxaloacetic Transaminase
plain_english_definition: Enzyme concentrated in liver, cardiac myocytes, and skeletal muscle tissue.
low_value_meaning: Normal expected finding.
high_value_meaning: Indicates liver injury (AST > ALT often in alcohol-related injury) or intense muscle breakdown.
diet_lifestyle_note: Evaluate concurrent medications and avoid heavy alcohol intake.

plain_english_definition: Enzyme associated with bile canaliculi and actively remodeling osteoblasts.
low_value_meaning: Can occur with zinc deficiency or severe malnutrition.
high_value_meaning: Indicates biliary obstruction (gallstones, cholestasis) or active bone turnover/healing.
diet_lifestyle_note: Consult for an abdominal ultrasound if right-upper-quadrant pain is present.

plain_english_definition: Yellow breakdown pigment from normal erythrocyte catabolism processed by hepatocytes.
low_value_meaning: Completely benign with no adverse diagnostic meaning.
high_value_meaning: Causes visible jaundice; indicates biliary obstruction, hepatic failure, or active hemolysis.
diet_lifestyle_note: Ensure adequate hydration and avoid high-fat meals if biliary colic is suspected.

plain_english_definition: Water-soluble bilirubin conjugated by liver enzymes for excretion into bile.
low_value_meaning: Expected physiological baseline.
high_value_meaning: Indicates post-hepatic biliary blockage (choledocholithiasis, stricture) or hepatitis.
diet_lifestyle_note: Requires medical assessment to differentiate obstructive vs. hepatocellular causes.

plain_english_definition: Major circulating oncotic protein synthesized by hepatocytes to retain vascular fluid.
low_value_meaning: Hypoalbuminemia; suggests advanced liver cirrhosis, nephrotic syndrome, or malnutrition.
high_value_meaning: Typically caused by acute dehydration and hemoconcentration.
diet_lifestyle_note: Incorporate high-quality dietary proteins (eggs, legumes, Greek yogurt, fish).

plain_english_definition: Sensitive enzyme present in biliary epithelial cells and endoplasmic reticulum of hepatocytes.
low_value_meaning: Expected and normal.
high_value_meaning: Very sensitive indicator of bile duct irritation, chronic alcohol consumption, or toxic liver injury.
diet_lifestyle_note: Abstain from alcohol if elevated; monitor alongside ALP.

plain_english_definition: Total sterol lipid circulating in lipoproteins, required for cell membranes and steroid hormones.
low_value_meaning: May accompany severe malnutrition, malabsorption, or severe liver impairment.
high_value_meaning: Hypercholesterolemia; major contributor to atherogenesis and coronary artery disease.
diet_lifestyle_note: Reduce dietary saturated and trans fats; increase soluble oat fiber and plant sterols.

plain_english_definition: Primary storage lipid circulating in blood, synthesized from excess dietary calories.
low_value_meaning: Common in very low-fat diets or malabsorption.
high_value_meaning: Increases cardiovascular risk; severe elevations (>500 mg/dL) trigger acute pancreatitis.
diet_lifestyle_note: Eliminate refined sugar beverages, cut simple starches, and stop alcohol consumption.

plain_english_definition: 'Good' anti-atherogenic lipoprotein that shuttles cholesterol back to the liver for excretion.
low_value_meaning: Low HDL increases risk of cardiovascular disease.
high_value_meaning: Generally considered cardioprotective.
diet_lifestyle_note: Engage in regular aerobic cardio workouts and consume healthy omega-3 fatty acids.

plain_english_definition: 'Bad' atherogenic lipoprotein that deposits cholesterol inside the subendothelial arterial wall.
low_value_meaning: Desirable in high-risk cardiac patients; rarely indicates nutritional deficit.
high_value_meaning: Significantly heightens lifetime risk of myocardial infarction and ischemic stroke.
diet_lifestyle_note: Strictly minimize deep-fried items, commercial bakery pastries, and hydrogenated oils.

synonyms: FBS, Fasting Glucose, Blood Glucose Fasting
plain_english_definition: Blood glucose concentration following an 8 to 12-hour overnight fast.
low_value_meaning: Hypoglycemia; triggers shakiness, diaphoresis, tachycardia, mental confusion, and syncope.
high_value_meaning: 100–125 mg/dL indicates prediabetes; ≥ 126 mg/dL confirms diabetes mellitus.
diet_lifestyle_note: Prioritize low-glycemic complex carbs, leafy greens, and balanced proteins.

synonyms: PPBS, Postprandial Glucose, 2-Hour Post Lunch Glucose
plain_english_definition: Blood glucose concentration measured exactly 2 hours after commencing a meal.
low_value_meaning: Reactive hypoglycemia caused by hyperinsulinemia.
high_value_meaning: 140–199 mg/dL indicates impaired glucose tolerance; ≥ 200 mg/dL diagnostic of diabetes.
diet_lifestyle_note: Take a 15-minute brisk walk post-meal to mitigate glucose excursion.

plain_english_definition: Percentage of hemoglobin with bound glucose, reflecting the average 3-month glycemic control.
low_value_meaning: Observed in chronic hemolytic anemia or following acute blood loss.
high_value_meaning: 5.7%–6.4% indicates prediabetes; ≥ 6.5% establishes chronic diabetes mellitus.
diet_lifestyle_note: Implement structured carbohydrate counting and consistent physical movement.

plain_english_definition: Anterior pituitary hormone regulating thyroid gland synthesis of metabolic hormones.
low_value_meaning: Suppressed TSH indicates hyperthyroidism (causing palpitations, anxiety, heat intolerance, weight loss).
high_value_meaning: Elevated TSH indicates primary hypothyroidism (causing lethargy, weight gain, constipation, depression).
diet_lifestyle_note: Ensure adequate dietary iodine intake; consult an endocrinologist for dosage titration.

plain_english_definition: Unbound biologically active hormone driving cellular metabolism and cardiac rate.
low_value_meaning: Observed in advanced hypothyroidism or non-thyroidal systemic critical illness.
high_value_meaning: Confirms clinical hyperthyroidism (Graves' disease, toxic multinodular goiter).
diet_lifestyle_note: Must be evaluated strictly in correlation with TSH and FT4 levels.

plain_english_definition: Unbound prohormone secreted by the thyroid gland, peripherally deiodinated into FT3.
low_value_meaning: Indicates primary hypothyroid function.
high_value_meaning: Indicates primary hyperthyroid state.
diet_lifestyle_note: Take prescribed levothyroxine fasting with a full glass of water 60 minutes before food.

plain_english_definition: Fat-soluble secosteroid essential for intestinal calcium uptake, bone density, and immune balance.
low_value_meaning: Deficiency (<20 ng/mL) causes osteomalacia, osteopenia, diffuse muscle aches, and fatigue.
high_value_meaning: Hypervitaminosis D; can lead to hypercalcemia, soft-tissue calcification, and renal stones.
diet_lifestyle_note: Regular safe morning sunlight exposure, fortified milk, egg yolks, and supplemental D3.

plain_english_definition: Cobalt-containing vitamin necessary for axonal myelin preservation, DNA synthesis, and RBC creation.
low_value_meaning: Severe deficiency causes peripheral neuropathy, brain fog, fatigue, and megaloblastic anemia.
high_value_meaning: Excess is typically cleared in urine; unexplained spikes may indicate hepatic disease.
diet_lifestyle_note: Essential for vegetarians and vegans to supplement or consume fortified foods.

plain_english_definition: Primary extracellular cation regulating osmolality, total water balance, and action potentials.
low_value_meaning: Hyponatremia; can cause nausea, headache, cerebral edema, confusion, and seizures.
high_value_meaning: Hypernatremia; typically indicates water deficit, dehydration, or diabetes insipidus.
diet_lifestyle_note: Rehydrate with oral rehydration salts rather than hypotonic free water if depleted.

plain_english_definition: Critical intracellular cation controlling cardiac electrical conductivity and neuromuscular excitability.
low_value_meaning: Hypokalemia; causes profound muscle weakness, paralytic ileus, and ventricular arrhythmias.
high_value_meaning: Hyperkalemia; critical medical emergency risking fatal cardiac arrhythmias and asystole.
diet_lifestyle_note: Bananas, coconut water, potatoes, and citrus fruits are high in potassium.

plain_english_definition: Most abundant mineral in the body; critical for bone structure, clotting cascade, and heart contraction.
low_value_meaning: Hypocalcemia; causes neuromuscular irritability, tetany, carpopedal spasm, and perioral numbness.
high_value_meaning: Hypercalcemia; seen in hyperparathyroidism, sarcoidosis, or occult bone malignancy.
diet_lifestyle_note: Pair calcium-rich foods (dairy, ragi, sesame) with adequate vitamin D for absorption.

plain_english_definition: Major extracellular anion maintaining electrical neutrality and acid-base equilibrium.
low_value_meaning: Seen with prolonged vomiting (loss of HCl) or metabolic alkalosis.
high_value_meaning: Seen with severe dehydration, kidney dysfunction, or metabolic acidosis.
diet_lifestyle_note: Maintain electrolyte homeostasis through balanced hydration.

synonyms: CRP, S. CRP, C-Reactive Protein Quantitative
plain_english_definition: Acute-phase hepatic protein that rises precipitously during inflammation or bacterial infection.
low_value_meaning: Minimal values confirm the absence of active systemic acute-phase inflammation.
high_value_meaning: Points to active bacterial infections, autoimmune flares (rheumatoid arthritis, lupus), or trauma.
diet_lifestyle_note: Anti-inflammatory nutrition (turmeric, olive oil, berries) supports chronic inflammation management.

plain_english_definition: High-sensitivity assay measuring low-grade vascular inflammation to gauge coronary risk.
low_value_meaning: Optimal low cardiovascular risk (<1.0 mg/L).
high_value_meaning: Levels >3.0 mg/L indicate high cardiovascular risk for atherosclerosis and plaque rupture.
diet_lifestyle_note: Address lifestyle risk factors, increase physical activity, and control cholesterol.

plain_english_definition: Nonspecific rate at which erythrocytes settle under gravity in 1 hour.
low_value_meaning: Expected normal baseline.
high_value_meaning: Non-specific marker for infection, connective tissue diseases, arthritis, or chronic kidney disease.
diet_lifestyle_note: Must be interpreted alongside CRP and clinical symptom presentations.

plain_english_definition: Contractile cardiac regulatory protein released exclusively upon myocardial cell death.
low_value_meaning: Normal baseline; rules out recent myocardial infarction if measured serially.
high_value_meaning: Critical indicator of acute myocardial infarction (heart attack) or acute myocarditis.
diet_lifestyle_note: Requires emergency medical intervention in an emergency room or coronary care unit.

plain_english_definition: Intracellular hollow protein shell storing elemental iron safely in tissues.
low_value_meaning: Gold-standard test for depleted iron stores; proves iron deficiency before overt anemia develops.
high_value_meaning: Elevated in hereditary hemochromatosis (iron overload) or as an acute-phase inflammatory marker.
diet_lifestyle_note: If low, oral iron replacement with citrus juice is indicated.

plain_english_definition: Immediate circulating iron bound to carrier transferrin in bloodstream.
low_value_meaning: Indicates dietary deficiency, active blood loss, or impaired absorption (celiac disease).
high_value_meaning: Iron poisoning, repeated blood transfusions, or metabolic storage defects.
diet_lifestyle_note: Avoid taking iron supplements together with tea or coffee as tannins inhibit absorption.

plain_english_definition: Capacity of serum transferrin proteins to bind additional iron ions.
low_value_meaning: Low TIBC occurs in iron overload, malnutrition, or chronic systemic inflammatory disease.
high_value_meaning: High TIBC is a classic physiological compensation seen in true iron deficiency anemia.
diet_lifestyle_note: Used in tandem with serum iron to calculate transferrin saturation percentage.

plain_english_definition: Time required for plasma to form a fibrin clot via extrinsic and common pathways.
low_value_meaning: Accelerated clotting; rare clinical relevance.
high_value_meaning: Prolonged clotting; seen with warfarin therapy, Vitamin K deficiency, or hepatic synthetic failure.
diet_lifestyle_note: Requires evaluation of bleeding risk before invasive procedures.

plain_english_definition: Standardized global calculation of PT to monitor oral anticoagulant therapy (e.g., warfarin).
low_value_meaning: Indicates sub-therapeutic anticoagulation in treated patients.
high_value_meaning: Elevated bleeding risk; therapeutically targeted between 2.0–3.0 in atrial fibrillation or DVT.
diet_lifestyle_note: Strict compliance with prescribed anticoagulant doses and regular dietary Vitamin K consistency.

plain_english_definition: Protein fibrin degradation fragment produced when an existing blood clot is broken down.
low_value_meaning: Strong negative predictive value; reliably rules out deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism.
high_value_meaning: Indicates active clot degradation (DVT, PE, DIC) or recent surgery and trauma.
diet_lifestyle_note: Prompt diagnostic imaging (ultrasound or CT angiography) warranted if clinically suspicious.

plain_english_definition: Digestive enzyme synthesized by acinar pancreatic cells and salivary glands to digest starch.
low_value_meaning: Rarely of diagnostic concern.
high_value_meaning: Marked elevation (>3x upper limit) is a classic indicator of acute pancreatitis.
diet_lifestyle_note: Avoid high-fat meals and alcohol; seek immediate evaluation for severe epigastric pain.

plain_english_definition: Enzyme synthesized by the pancreas that hydrolyzes dietary triglycerides into fatty acids.
low_value_meaning: Expected normal baseline.
high_value_meaning: More specific and longer-lasting than amylase for diagnosing acute pancreatitis.
diet_lifestyle_note: Requires clinical correlation with abdominal CT imaging.

plain_english_definition: Presence of albumin/protein molecules leaking through glomerular filtration barrier into urine.
low_value_meaning: Normal finding (should be completely negative).
high_value_meaning: Proteinuria; hallmark sign of diabetic nephropathy, hypertensive kidney damage, or glomerulonephritis.
diet_lifestyle_note: Tight blood pressure control with ACE inhibitors/ARBs preserves renal integrity.

plain_english_definition: Glucose excreted into urine when blood glucose exceeds renal tubular threshold (~180 mg/dL).
low_value_meaning: Normal finding (negative).
high_value_meaning: Indicates significant uncontrolled hyperglycemia or rare renal glycosuria.
diet_lifestyle_note: Immediate capillary blood sugar evaluation recommended.

plain_english_definition: Number of white blood cells visible in urine sediment under high-power microscopic field.
low_value_meaning: Normal baseline in sterile urine.
high_value_meaning: Pyuria; classic indication of urinary tract infection (cystitis, pyelonephritis) or urethritis.
diet_lifestyle_note: Increase fluid intake and consult for urine culture and appropriate antibiotics.

plain_english_definition: Presence of erythrocytes leaking into the urinary collecting system.
low_value_meaning: Normal finding in healthy urine.
high_value_meaning: Hematuria; can stem from urinary calculi (kidney stones), severe infection, or urothelial neoplasms.
diet_lifestyle_note: Urological ultrasound or cystoscopy indicated if painless hematuria persists.

plain_english_definition: Concentration ratio of urine relative to pure water, measuring renal concentrating ability.
low_value_meaning: Hyposthenuria; indicates high fluid intake or diabetes insipidus.
high_value_meaning: Hypersthenuria; classic sign of dehydration or glycosuria.
diet_lifestyle_note: Maintain steady, balanced fluid intake throughout the day.

plain_english_definition: Glycoprotein synthesized by prostatic epithelial cells into seminal fluid and serum.
low_value_meaning: Normal and reassuring finding in adult males.
high_value_meaning: Elevations suggest benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), prostatitis, or prostate adenocarcinoma.
diet_lifestyle_note: Requires digital rectal examination and urological review.

plain_english_definition: Unbound PSA fraction; Free-to-Total PSA ratio helps differentiate benign BPH from prostate cancer.
low_value_meaning: Low Free PSA ratio (<10%) raises suspicion of malignancy, prompting biopsy.
high_value_meaning: Higher Free PSA ratio (>25%) favors benign prostate enlargement over cancer.
diet_lifestyle_note: Utilized specifically when Total PSA is borderline (4.0–10.0 ng/mL).

plain_english_definition: Surface antigen glycoprotein tracked in gynecological and peritoneal conditions.
low_value_meaning: Normal healthy female baseline.
high_value_meaning: Elevated in epithelial ovarian carcinoma; mild rises also occur in endometriosis, fibroids, and pelvic inflammation.
diet_lifestyle_note: Pelvic transvaginal ultrasound or MRI indicated if values are abnormal.

plain_english_definition: Glycoprotein oncofetal antigen utilized for tracking colorectal, gastrointestinal, and lung tumors.
low_value_meaning: Expected adult non-smoker baseline.
high_value_meaning: Elevated in colorectal, gastric, or pancreatic adenocarcinoma; slight elevations in chronic smokers.
diet_lifestyle_note: Must be correlated with colonoscopy and diagnostic tissue biopsy.

plain_english_definition: Sialylated Lewis blood group antigen used in monitoring hepatobiliary and pancreatic conditions.
low_value_meaning: Normal healthy tissue baseline.
high_value_meaning: Elevated in pancreatic adenocarcinoma, cholangiocarcinoma, or benign gallstone biliary obstruction.
diet_lifestyle_note: Paired with contrast abdominal CT or magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP).

plain_english_definition: Mucin-derived glycoprotein antigen used in monitoring treatment response in breast cancer.
low_value_meaning: Standard baseline level.
high_value_meaning: Elevations seen in advanced or metastatic breast carcinoma; used to evaluate treatment response.
diet_lifestyle_note: Used primarily for disease monitoring during therapy rather than population screening.

plain_english_definition: Major fetal plasma protein synthesized by fetal liver; tracked in adults for liver and germ cell tumors.
low_value_meaning: Normal adult non-pregnant baseline.
high_value_meaning: Marked elevation suggests hepatocellular carcinoma (primary liver cancer) or germ cell tumors.
diet_lifestyle_note: Patients with chronic Hepatitis B/C or cirrhosis undergo surveillance with AFP and ultrasound.

plain_english_definition: Nuclear hormone receptor percentage in breast tumor cells; determines hormone receptor positivity.
low_value_meaning: ER Negative (<1%); tumor does not respond to anti-estrogen endocrine therapies.
high_value_meaning: ER Positive (≥1%); tumor growth is stimulated by estrogen; highly responsive to endocrine therapy.
diet_lifestyle_note: Guides targeted adjuvant hormonal therapy (e.g., tamoxifen or aromatase inhibitors).

plain_english_definition: Nuclear steroid hormone receptor; evaluated alongside ER in breast carcinoma specimens.
low_value_meaning: PR Negative (<1%); indicates lower hormone responsiveness.
high_value_meaning: PR Positive (≥1%); favorable predictive marker for endocrine therapy response.
diet_lifestyle_note: Evaluated in combination with ER and HER2 status to guide oncology management.

plain_english_definition: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 protein overexpressed on cell surfaces of certain cancers.
low_value_meaning: HER2 Negative (Score 0 or 1+); tumor lacks HER2 gene amplification.
high_value_meaning: HER2 Positive (Score 3+); aggressive tumor biology, but highly treatable with anti-HER2 targeted monoclonal antibodies.
diet_lifestyle_note: Score 2+ requires confirmatory FISH (Fluorescent In Situ Hybridization) testing.

plain_english_definition: Nuclear cellular protein marker that quantifies the fraction of tumor cells actively dividing.
low_value_meaning: Low proliferation (<14%); slower-growing, less aggressive tumor behavior.
high_value_meaning: High proliferation (>20-30%); rapidly dividing tumor cells, indicating higher histological grade.
diet_lifestyle_note: Crucial metric in determining whether adjuvant chemotherapy is warranted.

plain_english_definition: Distance from the outermost edge of resected tumor tissue to the ink-marked surgical cut boundary.
low_value_meaning: Positive margin (0 mm / tumor touches ink); residual microscopic disease likely present, often requiring re-excision.
high_value_meaning: Negative / Clear margin (>1 mm); complete macroscopic and microscopic removal achieved.
diet_lifestyle_note: Clear margins significantly reduce the probability of local disease recurrence.
